title: LibsDisguises bodies
description: Player NPCs turning into a baby zombie, sand, a diamond, a pig, an emerald and text

console: animus create ghoul world=world x=-7.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Ghoul
animus create sandy world=world x=-4.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Sandy
animus create gem world=world x=-1.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Gem
animus create porky world=world x=1.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Porky
animus create shown world=world x=4.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Emerald
animus create sign world=world x=7.5 y=61 z=7.5 folder=live name=Sign

d5: animus npc disguise shown "item_display setItemStack emerald"
d6: animus npc disguise sign "text_display setText Welcome"

beats.type: /animus npc disguise ghoul "zombie setBaby true setGlowing true setItemInMainHand iron_sword"

beats.result: Ghoul is a glowing baby zombie holding an iron sword
Sandy is a falling sand block
Emerald is an emerald item display
the whole row of six disguised NPCs

closing: Six player NPCs now wear LibsDisguises bodies
